text:
Change complete and submitted.

## Summary

Added a centralized warning logger and routed every CLI warning through it.

**`src/logger.h`**
- Added `inline auto LOG_WARNING() -> std::ostream &`, next to `LOG_VERBOSE`. It always writes `warning: ` to `std::cerr` and returns it, ignoring `--verbose` and all other options. Added `<iostream>` to the std include block.

**Converted all five warning sites** (searched the tree to confirm none remained):
- `src/command_lint.cc` — unknown-exclude warning (was `LOG_VERBOSE`, now always emits).
- `src/command_validate.cc` — invalid pre-compiled template, and the empty-JSONL warning (was `LOG_VERBOSE`, now always emits).
- `src/resolver.h` — the three-line "No schema resources…" warning chained under one `LOG_WARNING()` so the whole message carries one prefix.
- `src/command_bundle.cc` — the six-line `--without-id` warning chained under one `LOG_WARNING()`; added the `"logger.h"` include.

**Test**
- Updated `test/validate/pass_jsonl_empty.sh`'s expected stderr, since the empty-JSONL warning is now unconditional (registered test, unchanged registration).

## Evidence
- `make configure` / `make compile` — succeeded (clang-format + shellcheck + build + install + cpack), `Built target jsonschema_cli`.
- `cmake --build build --target clang_format_test` — clean, exit 0.
- `cmake --build build --target shellcheck` — clean, exit 0.
- `ctest --test-dir build -R 'pass_jsonl_empty' --output-on-failure` — 2/2 passed.
- Full `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -j4` — 301/301 passed.
- Manual checks confirmed unconditional warnings in non-verbose mode and a single `warning: ` prefix on multi-line warnings.
